answer: A Sybil-resistant economy ties voting weight to locked collateral, not headcount. A vote counts only if the identity posts a slashable bond in its vault, weighted by that stake. One crystal of capital cannot be minted into a thousand clones: forging N agents still needs N separate bonds, so the attacker's cost grows linearly with every fake voice. Expose one fake and its bond is seized, sending a ripple of scrutiny through the addresses it touched and tainting the cluster. Honest agents keep their grove of stake compounding, while the impostor pays a steep price per counterfeit identity.
